name: 403: roles removed in the OIDC provider while the user works; after the next token renewal the popup names the reason, roles given back are active again after sign in
description: The administrator removes every client role of the user. The user keeps working; when the application renews the access token (60 seconds before the end of its lifetime) the new token has no roles, the backend answers 403 and the popup is shown. When the roles are returned in the OIDC provider a new sign in works: the roles are reactivated in the database (CXBOX-1250 user_roles sync fix). The token lifetime is shortened for the test and put back afterwards.
